source_selection: Only current-G reader delta is proposed. The e3/55b writer-overlay requires put_bytes/options/contracts not present in the selected G IR protocol and is not imported.

minimum_C02_packet.methods: Current selected put_json(obj, opts, canon_spec), get_manifest(id), get_bytes(id), iter_artifact_ids() with exact source blobs.
minimum_C02_packet.manifest_read: Complete persisted CanonInfo model field set, strict scalars, supported polisyos.canon.json@0.2.0 name/version and nonnegative integer depth; JSON separators lists admitted only when exactly two strings. These fields describe codec ABI and confer no custody authority.
minimum_C02_packet.options: Reconcile every actual ArtifactWriteOptions dataclass field through the selected adapter using a fully nondefault legitimate sample and generic field-derived comparison; preserve typed tenant/input/authority/warning semantics. Only genuinely type-constrained default-only fields may be exempt.
minimum_C02_packet.observed_options_boundary: Current G _coerce_write_options returns the historical subset; foreign tenant_context/same_input_closure/authority/warnings are not forwarded when options are supplied through the non-Core coercion path. No complete metadata-forwarding claim is made by C06 reader tests.
minimum_C02_packet.raw_Core_boundary: Direct Core put_json can emit Core-only float_hex/bytes_hex/array_digest payloads under the same default canon name/version; IR deliberate narrower tag refusal remains. C02/G must choose the selected raw emission/profile/bypass contract before whole LA-021 closure.
minimum_C02_packet.historical_compatibility: This reader proposal rejects profile-less persisted manifests. G must explicitly admit the narrower supported limitation or provide an existing source-qualified historical profile contract before deployment; no stored bytes or CAS IDs are rewritten.

required_discriminators: Current IR producer -> FileSystemCAS -> fresh complete untouched JSON-mode Mapping read, Decimal bytes/hash identity and supported depth129.
Malformed/unsupported/missing canon and every individually omitted runtime model field refuse before byte read.
Selected full legitimate write metadata reaches typed manifest without identity/default substitution; a foreign selected-input profile reaches Core admission and produces zero child writes.
Raw Core tag emission with unchanged name/version markers must remain distinguishable from the supported IR profile. Do not reinterpret the narrower reader as a writer strangle.
Remove only metadata forwarding or selected input-profile propagation while preserving field names; the generic option/foreign-admission oracle must fail on the selected owner mechanism.
next_owner: C02 canonical Core write/profile/options owner and G composition/historical compatibility decision. C06 owns only reader adapter/tests and will rerun affected consumers after that specific frozen delta.
measurement_boundary: Requirements and exact-source review only; no new Core source, no new metadata-forwarding/protected-admission runtime proof, no external/historical client absence.
